slides.headline: Red Bull Flugtag at Bayfront Park
slides.body: Saturday, Oct. 31 from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. at Bayfront Park in Miami. Admission is free. Teams launch homemade flying machines over the water.

photo.query: Red Bull Flugtag Bayfront Park Miami flying machine crowd
photo.prompt: A wide, dramatic photo of a homemade flying machine at Bayfront Park with the water, the launch deck and a crowd watching

slides.headline: Spooktacular Miami City Cemetery Walking Tour
slides.body: Friday, Oct. 30 at 5 p.m. at Miami City Cemetery in Miami. Tickets cost $35 for adults and $15 for children 14 and under. The tour mixes local history with a Halloween walk.

photo.query: Miami City Cemetery night walking tour historic graves
photo.prompt: A moody evening photo of Miami City Cemetery with flashlight-lit visitors, old graves and a historic path

slides.headline: Halloween Party at Deli Lane and Sunset Tavern
slides.body: Saturday, Oct. 31 at 10 a.m. at Deli Lane and Sunset Tavern in South Miami. Admission is free. Live music, cocktails and a costume contest are on the schedule.

photo.query: Deli Lane Sunset Tavern South Miami halloween party exterior
photo.prompt: A specific night-or-day photo of Deli Lane and Sunset Tavern with Halloween decor, people in costume and the entrance clearly visible

slides.headline: Rosa Obscura at Rosa Sky Rooftop
slides.body: Friday, Oct. 30 to Saturday, Oct. 31 at Rosa Sky Rooftop in Miami. The event runs as a Halloween rooftop party.
slides.source: Our posts from the last week

photo.query: Rosa Sky Rooftop Miami Halloween rooftop night
photo.prompt: A dramatic rooftop nightlife scene at Rosa Sky with skyline lights, costumes, cocktails and a clear rooftop setting

slides.headline: Day of the Dead at CityPlace Doral
slides.body: Sunday, Nov. 1 at 4 p.m. at CityPlace Doral in Doral. Admission is free with RSVP. The event includes folkloric dancers, stilt walkers and mariachis.

photo.query: CityPlace Doral Day of the Dead event colorful crowd
photo.prompt: A colorful daytime photo of CityPlace Doral with Day of the Dead decor, performers in costume and a lively plaza

slides.headline: The Rocky Horror Picture Show at Miami Beach Bandshell
slides.body: Sunday, Nov. 1 at 7 p.m. at Miami Beach Bandshell in Miami Beach. Tickets cost $35. The screening includes drag performances, a live shadowcast and a costume contest.

photo.query: Miami Beach Bandshell night Rocky Horror event crowd
photo.prompt: A striking nighttime photo of Miami Beach Bandshell with stage lights, costumed guests and the outdoor venue clearly visible
